lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three to four primary horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular blobs are clearly visible posterior to the gill slits. The central rows exhibit the highest spatial consistency and peak pixel intensity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with horizontal ridges and spot rows to form a defined grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-intensity specular highlights on the dorsal edge and deep shadow gradients on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible lateral surface of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 distinct high-luminance blobs arranged in a sparse, non-uniform distribution.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette of a secondary organism, likely a remora, is visible positioned immediately ventral to the primary pectoral fin.
